content: The information provided does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or suitable for your use. This information is not intended to replace individualized medical advice and should not be used as a substitute for the guidance of your healthcare professional. Always consult your healthcare provider for comprehensive information about this product and your specific health needs. In the event of an overdose, if the individual exhibits severe symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, immediately call emergency services (911). Otherwise, contact a poison control center without delay. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222, and Canadian residents can call 1-844-764-7669. If you are using this product for an extended period, it is essential to undergo laboratory and/or medical tests (e.g., blood mineral levels) while taking this medication. Ensure that you attend all scheduled medical and laboratory appointments. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. However, if it is close to the time of your next scheduled dose, skip the missed dose and proceed with your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to make up for the missed one. Store this product at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Do not freeze it. Do not dispose of medications by flushing them down the toilet or pouring them into a drain unless specifically instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed, following local disposal regulations. This information was last revised in September 2024. It is important to note that this is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. The information provided does not ensure that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. It is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Always seek complete information from your healthcare provider regarding this product and your specific health requirements. Adding plans allows you to compare the formulary status of this product with other drugs in the same class. To view formulary information, first create a list of plans. Your list will be saved and can be edited at any time. Individual plans may vary, and formulary information is subject to change. Contact the relevant plan provider for the most up-to-date information. If you choose to send this information to a recipient, they will receive additional details and instructions on how to access the offer.
